visual_observations: Monochrome partial exterior image showing two storeys with a broad front-facing gable roof and modest overhang.
Three rectangular sash-window bays are visible on each of two above-grade levels; several windows have dark shutters.
Three small circular vents form a cluster high in the front gable.
An upper corner porch/balcony with posts and a simple vertical balustrade wraps around the adjacent side; an entrance door is below/behind the porch.
A low row of small basement windows and landscaped foundation planting is visible.
At least two window air-conditioner units are visible.
The wall appears light and smooth; grayscale image does not establish its actual color or roofing material.
interpretation: The operator photo-tour navigation identifies a Floor Two, and the exterior photograph independently shows two above-grade window levels. This supports modeling two above-grade levels. The image also informs roof, porch, and shutter vocabulary, but not their dimensions.
limitations: The photograph has no scale, measured elevation, or georeferenced camera orientation.
Trees obscure the lower wall and the photo shows only part of the building.
The campus-facing side and exact locations of the porch, doors, windows, and roof wings remain approximate.
The image does not resolve the official GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 attribute's counting convention.
source_crs: Not applicable; web page contains no geometry or dimensions. GIS transform is separately documented in evidence.json.
